The National Research & Education Network (NREN)

As National Research & Education Network (NREN), Belnet helps Belgian knowledge institutions and governments to maximise the opportunities of the digital acceleration. With the highest-performance internet connection in the country and associated services, we are an engine for scientific and societal progress.

20 Oct. 2026

Belnet Community Day 2026: Connecting people, ideas and communities

On 15 October 2026, we brought the Belnet community together in Brussels for the second edition of Belnet Community Day. A day filled with inspiring conversations, fresh perspectives and opportunities to connect with the people behind our community. For me, this edition was particularly special. Not only was I involved in bringing the event to life behind the scenes, but I also had the opportunity to step into the spotlight as a speaker during one of the lightning talks.
